items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: she had gotten a head waiter, whose name was Jimmy Marsellini, an Italian fellow.

ctx.x: And you -- I don't remember -- Mr. Taudisac (?) was the proprietor of the place.

She made arrangements with him, to take over his place. It was a much bigger place. She redecorated and everything, and opened, and she had gotten a head waiter, whose name was Jimmy Marsellini, an Italian fellow.
